purpose: Evaluate evidence-linked prospective critique, severity, response classes, and simulation boundaries.

cases.mode: shared protocol routing, not manuscript ownership
cases.task: Apply the review protocol separately to: 全面审查这份生信研究方案，给出采用建议; 审查这个 Skill 是否会误触发; 认真审查这份图表的源数据对应关系。
must_include: three read-only reviewers for each explicit review
must_not: route all reviews primarily to reviewer-simulation

cases.task: Apply the review protocol separately to: 检查这个单词拼写; review是什么意思; 交付前轻量自检就好。
must_include: zero additional reviewers for all three requests
must_not: trigger from the word review alone

cases.task: Please review this supplied manuscript. I want a substantive assessment.
must_include: no author concerns or other reports in reviewer input
must_not: retroactively edit reports to manufacture diversity
treat majority vote as scientific proof

cases.task: Only give one quick reviewer assessment of this abstract.
Review this draft with three independent reviewers, but the runtime only allows a shared context.
must_include: offer bounded single review or separate invocations
must_not: claim three role-played voices are independent

cases.task: Simulate likely reviewer concerns for a complete computational biology manuscript.
must_include: evidence-linked Critical Major and Minor concerns

cases.task: Simulate review using only an abstract and main figures.
must_include: materials needed for a stronger simulation

cases.task: Red-team reference versions, filtering, statistics, workflow pinning, and reproducibility.
must_not: assume missing detail means incorrect analysis

cases.task: Classify prospective concerns by the work needed to answer them.
must_not: draft replies to nonexistent real comments as completed actions

cases.task: Simulate reviewer concerns about docking and ADMET claims.
must_not: treat ADMET prediction as safety proof
